spans.s: To set out for; dive or plunge into; गाधितासे नभो भूयः
To seek, search or inquire for.
To compile, string or weave together.
गध्य [gadhya], a. Ved. To be seized (as booty); ऋज्रा वाजं न गध्यं युयूषन्
गाध [gādha], a. [गाध्-भवादौ घञ्] Fordable, not very deep, shallow; सरितः कुर्वती गाधाः पथश्चाश्यानकर्दमान्
Consequence, result; स वै व्यसनमासाद्य गाधमार्तो न विन्दति

गाधिः [gādhiḥ] गाधिन् [gādhin], गाधिन् m. [गाध्-इन्] N. of the father of Viśvā mitra. (He is supposed to have been an incarnation of Indra and born as the son of king Kauśāmba.)-Comp. -जः, -नन्दनः, -पुत्रः an epithet of Viśvāmitra.-नगरम्, -पुरम् an epithet of Kānyakubja, the modern Kanoja.
